svg.aria-label: Credential flow: the operator stores the real LiteLLM key in the OpenShell gateway as provider litellm; the sandbox policy gets _provider_litellm; the agent only holds a placeholder and calls POST /v1/chat/completions; the supervisor matches the policy, swaps the placeholder for the real key and forwards to LiteLLM and the upstream model. A call to POST /key/generate is denied at L7 with a 403 and logged as an OCSF event in Loki.
svg.title: The key the agent never sees
svg.desc: Credential flow: the operator stores the real LiteLLM key in the OpenShell gateway as provider litellm; the sandbox policy gets _provider_litellm; the agent only holds a placeholder and calls POST /v1/chat/completions; the supervisor matches the policy, swaps the placeholder for the real key and forwards to LiteLLM and the upstream model. svg.text: The key the agent never sees
Credential injection with an OpenShell provider: the real key stays in the gateway and the supervisor
The real key exists only in the gateway's provider store and on the supervisor's outbound request.
The agent process only ever holds the placeholder, so a prompt-injected agent has no key to leak.
